headline: Japan’s GMO Internet Warns Users of Impending Ransomware Attack
summary: Japan-based GMO Internet warned its users of an impending ransomware cyberattack threatening its digital systems.
why: Cybersecurity incidents involving major internet and financial technology providers expose operational vulnerabilities and potential compliance risks.

impacts.name: GMO Internet Group, Inc.
impacts.why: Ransomware warnings and potential cyber disruptions can impair operational continuity and erode customer trust.
